body.message:
Hi,

My name is Chiamaka Grace, I support Airbnb hosts and property managers with the day-to-day operations that keep their listings running smoothly and profitably.

With over 3 years experience managing listings across Airbnb, Booking.com and other OTAs, I focus on:

• Guest communication and inquiry handling 
• Calendar and booking management 
• Listing optimization and performance improvement 
• Issue resolution and smooth guest experience 
• Administrative support

I understand that behind every successful listing is consistent communication, fast response time, and attention to detail.
With my experience in the Dubai rental market, I handle community registrations, sakani move-ins and outs and lots more.

I’d be happy to offer a few weeks of my support at no cost, giving you the opportunity to evaluate my skills and see how I can effectively support your operations.

If you find my services valuable after the trial, I’d be happy to discuss a paid, longer-term engagement that works for both of us.

I’m available to start immediately and would love the opportunity to support you. I’d be happy to share my CV for your review.

Regards, 
Chiamaka Grace.
